name: Healthy
overview: Scripture reveals that true health is closely connected to obedience and faithfulness to God, as He promises healing and protection from sickness when His commandments are followed (Exodus 15:26; Exodus 23:25). The Psalms affirm God's power to heal all diseases, restore the brokenhearted, and deliver from destruction (Psalms 103:3; 107:20; 147:3). This divine healing sustains life, enabling believers to live and proclaim God's works (Psalms 118:17). Thus, a healthy life encompasses spiritual obedience, physical well-being, and the assurance of God's restorative grace.
